name: brandpulse-sentiment-eval
guidelines: label = overall sentiment toward the brand/product expressed by title + snippet together.
Facts, announcements, specs, how-tos and questions without an opinion are neutral.
Genuinely mixed items are labeled by the dominant tone; when no tone dominates they are neutral.
aspects = every lexicon aspect the annotator saw in the text, with the sentiment of the clause that mentions it. Aspects not listed were not annotated, so detection precision is not reported.

Provenance: 'fixture:*' items come from tests/fixtures/serpapi (synthetic snippets from Phase 2); 'handwritten' items were written for this set. No live SerpApi data was used. Labels were assigned by one annotator (the implementing agent), not by independent human raters.
